speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether overseas retailers of consumer goods are allowed to supply labour to install such goods in Singapore for Singapore customers if such labour do not have the requisite permits to work in Singapore; and (b) if not, whether the Ministry has any enforcement plans to keep the playing field level for local retailers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: This helps to ensure that all businesses are operating on a level playing field.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Anyone with information on such illegal workers should report to MOM.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: I wish to ask the Minister, as a clarification, whether she can give more assurances to small businesses.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: For example, a resident whom I visited was a furniture reseller.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: Can there be assurance that MOM is doing what it can to try and level the playing field to protect our businesses?

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: A lot of them feel aggrieved that they have been prejudiced by retailers from Malaysia who cross the Causeway and help to deliver and install furniture in consumers' houses in Singapore.
